detail:
New decision "Chose to implement dismissal tombstones in the tool handler appending to the archive jsonl rather than a soft-delete status" relates to:
- 01KHXTX64263644BDF1JDRFD30: "Fix race conditions by using single index lock for atomic file+index updates in DecisionStore and HandoffStore"
- 01KWK9KV4JQP61XDP1GDFXP764: "Cross-process write-safety fixes from the multiwriter soak: exclusive-create (O_EXCL) for all file pre-creates, BEGIN IMMEDIATE around every sqlite read-modify-write, and lock retry budget (~24s) raised past the stale threshold (10s)"
- 01KWK9KV5FW2NC9RA2SJ4G0C57: "Export tree excludes agents and embeddings, and ingest never deletes without the corresponding kind directory present"
- 01KWMS1ETGRRNV4BW25Q1CQHJA: "Fixed the multiwriter-soak crash-tolerance flake by giving the victim writer an unfinishable op budget (VICTIM_OPS = OPS*100)"
- 01KWT95C6HJ382RN2X04CM27AV: "migrate --reverse now restores config version to 1 (forward finalize stamps 2)"
- 01KWT95C9X8RE8M9Z77N72Q475: "Publish workflow gained a tag-vs-package.json version guard and prerelease GH-release marking alongside the dist-tag routing; checkout/setup-node bumped to v5"
- 01KWX2CCWHH3QVCASADJ8N0TRZ: "Back-link rides the existing updateStatus(id, status, extra) path — no IDecisionStore interface change, no sqlite schema column"
- 01KWX2CD0DTRMWETSZEQGTVVG8: "Moved the supersede status flip in DecisionEngine.decide from before create to after create, writing status and superseded_by in one updateStatus call; conflict scan now excludes the supersede target"
- 01KWX2CD4YXB4HT5WBFKD0J4RT: "Housekeeping backfill preserves the target's current status — it writes only the missing superseded_by pointer, never flips active/archived/overridden to superseded"
- 01KWX2CD96VAG2X662E2B4MDVC: "Backfill pass runs by default (no opt-in flag), preview-reports / execute-applies like dedup; dangling supersedes targets are counted and skipped; newest supersessor wins when several point at one target"
- 01KWX2CDDJ2WKGD12X966SE96M: "why() emits superseded_by only when set (spread-conditional) rather than always-present nullable"
- 01KZC2MTBJG8SC2YEAJHVE9CMX: "Chose to run the marker verification against the live plugin server instead of a local build"
- 01KZCJP8A2B6RTYPA41N2V0APM: "Chose first-resolve-wins idempotency for re-resolves"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 13 existing decision(s) overlap
